source: GET http://<mac>:8088/usage  (bridge.py). The device polls this every 10s.
note: These are the ONLY fields available to draw. Don't invent data. History/series are NOT available unless the bridge is extended to send them.

fields.ok: bool — true if the bridge served fresh data. false/unreachable => stale.
fields.ts: int — unix seconds of this snapshot.
fields.account: string — Claude account label shown in the header (email or custom).

session.cost: float USD spent in the current 5-hour block
session.tokens: int tokens in the current block
session.budget: float USD that = 100% on the session bar (user-set)
session.resets_in_min: int — minutes until the 5-hour block resets
session.active: bool — false when no session is currently running (idle)

weekly.cost: float USD since the weekly reset
weekly.tokens: int tokens since the weekly reset
weekly.budget: float USD that = 100% on the weekly bar (user-set)
weekly.days: int — number of active days counted in this window
weekly.resets_in_min: int — minutes until the weekly reset (can be days; format as Nd Nh)
weekly.resets_at: string — short human reset time, e.g. 'Thu 08:00'

states: boot_connecting  — no data yet, WiFi connecting (account empty). status: 'Connecting WiFi...'
boot_fetching    — WiFi up, first fetch in flight. status: 'Fetching usage...'
boot_waiting     — WiFi up but bridge unreachable. status: 'Waiting for bridge...'
dashboard_stale  — ok=false: show last values but flag the status spark red
